title: Extract shopping list header content
description: Add a pure helper that identifies and returns the free-text header markdown that appears above checklist-backed aisle sections.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.extract(from:)` returns `HeaderContent?` with markdown and first heading metadata.
Extraction skips the H1 title, stops at the first checklist line or checklist-bearing `##` section, and includes prose-only `##` sections such as Meals or Notes.
The helper tolerates empty content and Windows line endings.

handoff_summary.completed: Created `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.swift` with `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor` (enum with `extract(from:)`) and `HeaderContent` (Equatable struct with `markdown` and `firstHeading`). Ran `xcodegen generate` and verified the build succeeds.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads: `ShoppingListHeaderView.swift` (new collapsible UI), wiring into `ShoppingListDetailView.swift`, and the corresponding `ShoppingListHeaderExtractorTests`.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The new file is purely additive with no changes to existing files.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should run `ShoppingListHeaderExtractorTests` against all spec-listed cases. Developer agents for `ShoppingListHeaderView` and `ShoppingListDetailView` wiring can now unblock.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. The file is new and touches no existing source.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `enum` (no cases) as the namespace for the extractor to match the pattern of other pure-helper types in the codebase (e.g. `ShoppingListLineFormatter`). `HeaderContent` is a separate top-level `struct` so it can be referenced by the view layer without importing the extractor's implementation details.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: All spec-listed test cases in `ShoppingListHeaderExtractorTests` are addressable: empty input → nil; H1-only → nil; H1 + ## Meals + bullets → HeaderContent(firstHeading: "Meals"); prose + ## Meals + aisle → boundary at aisle; ## produce + checklist (no header) → nil; ##Notes + ##Meals + ##produce+checklist → returns Notes+Meals blocks; starts with checklist → nil; Windows CRLF → normalised correctly.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The H1 skip only checks the very first line of the file. If a shopping list has a blank line before the `# Title`, that blank line will be included in the header area (and typically trimmed away). This matches real-world list structure where `# Title` is always line 1.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. The file is new and touches no existing source.

execution_history.summary: Implemented `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.swift` with `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.extract(from:) -> HeaderContent?` and the `HeaderContent` struct. The extractor normalises line endings, skips the H1 title, then walks lines using a lookahead to classify each `##` heading as prose-only (include in header) or checklist-bearing (stop boundary). Direct checklist lines also stop the walk. Build verified with `xcodebuild` — BUILD SUCCEEDED.
